'''Zai-Uram''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="Dantooine" />

==Biography==
Zai-Uram was part of the Republic garrison on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the third Galactic War. When Dantooine was [[Dantooine Incursion|invaded]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Nova Blades]], he and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Vindo]] took command of the defense.<ref name="Dantooine" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Zai-Uram is a character from [[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]. He first appeared as one of the Republic contacts for "The Pirate Incursion" event on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] alongside [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Vindo]]. He can be flirted with by players of either [[Gender/Legends|sex]].<ref name="Dantooine" />
